slides.title: Year Badme was awarded to Eritrea
slides.body: Why Badme is in the news.

slides.text: Daily News Egypt reports Badme was a flashpoint of the **1998-2000 border conflict**, then awarded to **Eritrea in 2002** by a boundary commission.
Per the same report, **Ethiopia kept control** of Badme until the **2018 peace deal** between the two countries.
Residents told **BBC Amharic** on Nov 14 that families are leaving villages near Badme. **No casualty figures** have been published.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
